explication: Windows Calculator is a multi-mode calculator app: users enter calculations or choose a feature, and the app presents results through its Windows UI. The documented modes include standard, scientific, programmer, date, and graphing; other major capabilities are history, memory, unit conversion, and currency conversion. The sampled native code shows the interop wrapper creating the manager, which selects and drives calculation engines and reports display callbacks. The tree and README establish additional feature areas, but their internal call wiring was not sampled, so those links are kept conservative.
